SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ギュリさん これどうぞ

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Huh? You’re giving this to me?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: えっ 私にくれるんですか??
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Hah? Kamu ngasih ini ke aku?

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 네! 저 때문에 땀도 이렇게 흘리시는데...
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Yeah! You’re sweating because of me...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 是啊！你因为我都流这么多汗了...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 對啊！因為我，讓你流了這麼多汗...
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: はい! 僕のせいでこんなに汗かいてらっしゃるし…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Iya! Kamu jadi keringetan gara-gara aku...
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Sim! Você está suando por minha causa...
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: آره به خاطر من عرق می کنی...

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 칼로리 소모했을 때 바나나 먹는 게 그렇게 좋다고 하더라고요!
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I heard bananas are great after burning calories!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 听说消耗卡路里后吃香蕉特别好！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 聽說消耗熱量後，吃香蕉對身體特別好！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: カロリー消費した時にバナナ食べるのってすごくいいらしいですよ!
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Katanya pisang bagus lho setelah bakar kalori!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ouvi dizer que comer uma banana faz bem depois de fazer muito esforço.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Escuché que comer un plátano es bueno después de hacer mucho esfuerzo.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: شنیده ام که موز بعد از کالری سوزی عالی است!

SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あ 本当ですか? ありがとうございます

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Wow... you’re really going for it.
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: わぁ…すごく美味しそうに食べますね
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Uau... eu realmente estava com fome.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: You can give me the peel, if you want.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 香蕉皮可以给我来处理
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 皮は僕にくれてもいいですけど
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kulitnya kasih ke aku aja, kalau mau.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: La cáscara me la puede dar a mí.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: در صورت تمایل می توانید پوست اونو به من بدهید.
